mods.name: Infinity Castle
mods.description: An endless, procedurally generated castle of shoji corridors and upside-down rooms, inspired by the Infinity Castle (Mugen-jō) from Demon Slayer. Gravity and the camera flip as you move between floors.

releases.notes:
First release of the Infinity Castle: an endless castle of fusuma-walled rooms, lantern-lit bridges and upside-down halls for Minecraft 26.3 on Fabric, where gravity and the camera flip as you move between floors.

The twelve buildings, the bridges and the long staircases were designed block by block in Minecraft and imported into the mod; every world seed arranges them differently.

## Install

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) for Minecraft 26.3.
2. Put `infinity-castle-0.1.0.jar` and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for 26.3 in your `mods` folder. The `infinity-castle-0.1.0-mods.zip` download below bundles both jars with install notes.
3. The mod is needed on both the client and the server.

Craft a biwa (string, ender pearl, dark oak planks) and use it to enter the castle; use it again to leave. Operators can use `/infinitycastle enter`.

## Highlights

- Hand-designed rooms in four styles (plain, banded, veranda, veranda-banded) laid out procedurally on sixteen double-sided floors that wrap vertically.
- Gravity flips at each floor's equator; players walk on ceilings with mirrored stepping, jumping, fall damage and eye height. Stairwells climb through a roof hatch and up a 45° staircase to the gravity gate.
- Camera rolls with gravity, mirrored controls while inverted, per-floor tilt and drifting gravity.
- Skyless dimension with ember-red fog and a red–amber colour grade.
- Blocks: fusuma, tatami, shoji wall, shoji screen, lacquered planks, paper lantern. Item: biwa.
- English and Japanese translations.

*Unofficial fan project inspired by Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba; not affiliated with or endorsed by the rights holders.*
